pieces.styleNotes: Use a small orange pumpkin-shaped hat. Real hats differ from the reference's padded orange-and-charcoal velvet panels.

options.title: Pumpkin Beret Hat
options.notes: Orange knitted pumpkin hat with green stem; a soft full-size beret rather than a tiny padded velvet fascinator. Adult variant verified available. Merchant offers worldwide shipping; page states most orders arrive in 5–12 days, without a date guarantee.

options.title: Halloween Beret
options.notes: Select Orange Pumpkin. Soft felt orange beret with a black jack-o-lantern face, not a segmented velvet pumpkin. Merchant feed shows two Orange Pumpkin units available. USA ground and expedited shipping offered.

options.title: Crochet Pumpkin Beret
options.notes: Handmade orange crochet pumpkin beret in acrylic yarn with stem. Adult 22-inch variant is $55 and available in the live feed. Made to order; merchant does not state a fixed production interval. Adult size is listed as 22 inches. This is knitted rather than the reference's padded orange-and-charcoal velvet.

gaps: No finished hat exactly matches the reference's tiny padded orange-and-charcoal pumpkin. The higher-price handmade hat is crochet rather than velvet.

pieces.styleNotes: DIY base: add the separately listed orange felt diamonds. These fitted black unitards do not include diamonds, balloon sleeves, orange cuffs, or a collar.
queries: black long sleeve full length unitard DIY harlequin

options.title: Zip Front Spandex Long Sleeve Turtleneck Unitard
options.notes: Plain black fitted unitard, 85% nylon/15% spandex, long sleeves, full-length legs, mock neck and front zipper. All listed black sizes are available at $42.99. DIY orange diamonds are required; not a finished harlequin costume. The sleeve and trouser volume differs from the reference.

options.title: 83028GD - Garment Dye Long Sleeve Unitard
options.notes: Black heavyweight 95% cotton/5% elastane fitted unitard with long sleeves, scoop front and back. All listed black sizes are available at $70. DIY diamonds required; no ruff or orange cuffs included. Final sale per merchant. Fitted shape differs from the reference's loose velvet jumpsuit.

options.title: Second Skin Catsuit
options.notes: Matte opaque black 93% nylon/7% spandex catsuit includes fingers and individually covered toes. Merchant permits cutting at wrists or ankles without runs. One Size fits XS–XL; live embedded inventory shows three dyed Black One Size units. Black Plus Size has zero dyed stock and is excluded. DIY diamonds required; fitted silhouette differs. Page lists production ship date October 26, not arrival.

gaps: No verified ready-made orange-and-charcoal diamond jumpsuit was found. This catalog uses the design's stated felt-diamond DIY method. Sewing and ordinary scissors, needle, and thread are needed; these tools are not included.

pieces.styleNotes: Cut orange diamonds and sew them onto the black base. All choices are raw fabric, not pre-cut shapes or finished costumes. Preserve stretch between patches.
queries: pumpkin orange felt yard DIY harlequin diamonds

options.title: Pumpkin Wool Blend Felt
options.notes: Pumpkin is an orange heathered wool/rayon blend, approximately 1 mm thick. Price buys one 1/2-yard cut, approximately 18 x 36 inches. It is closer to burnt orange than bright acrylic felt. Cut and sew diamonds yourself; quantity depends on garment size and coverage. Multiple half-yard units yield an uncut sheet per merchant. Tools and thread are not included.

options.title: Orange Acrylic Felt Fabric / 1.6mm Thick _ 72” Wide
options.notes: Price buys one 36 x 72 inch yard of bright orange 100% acrylic felt, 1.6 mm thick and 300 gsm. Raw fabric only; cut and sew diamonds yourself. Brighter and thicker than the reference's burnt-orange velvet. Merchant advertises same-day dispatch before 1 PM PT; confirm the applicable business day at checkout.

options.title: Orange Acrylic Felt
options.notes: Price buys one yard of 72-inch-wide orange 100% acrylic felt, 5-ounce weight. Choose fabric rather than the $3 swatch. Raw fabric only; cut and sew diamonds yourself. Solid orange craft felt differs from velvet. Quantity depends on garment size and pattern coverage.

gaps: Fabric amounts and material differ by tier. Lay out the chosen diamond pattern before deciding the quantity. More fabric may be needed for dense all-over coverage.

pieces.styleNotes: A broad gathered textile ruff frames the face. Real choices use orange/black fabric rather than the reference's solid burnt-orange velvet.

options.title: Clown Collar - Black/Orange
options.notes: Underwraps two-part ruffled collar with tie closure, black with orange trim. Only collar included. Page has product-level instock metadata. Different color balance and fabric from the all-orange velvet reference. Chicago store ships in the USA; website asks customers needing October 31 delivery to choose express, which is not a delivery guarantee.

options.title: Custom Colors clowncore neck collar neck ruff ruffle two tone half & half ribbon tie Pierrot Clown cosplay Harlequin Halloween costume
options.notes: Custom cotton two-layer gathered collar, longest layer 6 inches. Select Orange and Black and give the desired ribbon color. Actual merchant photo shows sample color combinations, not a dedicated orange/black variant photo. Seller lists orange and black fabric swatches and $30 base price, but live color-selector stock is not independently verifiable. Allow up to one week to make before shipping from Rhode Island. Only collar included.

options.title: Custom Colors Adult Clown Collar Clowncore Ruffle Adjustable PomPom Customizable Costume Cosplay Halloween Circus Theatrical Unisex
options.notes: Made-to-order ruffle collar with handmade pom-poms and long adjustable ties; only collar included. Shown actual orange/black sample matches the palette. Choose Orange and Black for the pictured version, or Orange twice for solid orange. Listing has $40 price and add-to-cart, but live per-color selector stock is unverified. Ships from Connecticut; maker says it does not dispatch immediately. Current page estimates November 9–23 delivery, so this is not an October 31 promise.

gaps: The custom collar listings accept orders, but color-specific inventory cannot be confirmed. Their photos are real merchant samples; custom selected colors may differ. The in-stock default is the fixed black/orange Underwraps collar.

pieces.styleNotes: Plain black full-finger gloves are optional. Wrist-length styles sit under cuffs; opera-length styles can extend under sleeves. The $95 Second Skin base already covers the fingers, so separate gloves are unnecessary with that choice.

options.title: Adult Short Gloves
options.notes: Black short full-finger costume gloves; select Black. No hat or garment included. Merchant does not specify fiber content. Black variant available at $5.95. USA shipping offered.

options.title: Parade Snap Gloves
options.notes: Black parade gloves with wrist-snap cuffs. Full-finger short gloves rather than the reference's optional unspecified black gloves. Black variant verified available. USA shipping offered.

options.title: Black Velvet Opera Length Gloves
options.notes: Pair of black stretch velvet opera-length gloves reaches above the elbow. Longer than needed, but can sit under long sleeves; velvet texture suits the costume. No garment or collar included. Available at $27.95. Hand wash and lay flat to dry.

pieces.styleNotes: Black ankle boots finish the look. Prefer a pointed toe and modest heel. Laces, buckles, and almond toes are honest deviations.

options.title: Victorian-35
options.notes: Black vegan faux-leather lace-up ankle boots with pointed vintage silhouette and 2.75-inch kitten heel. More visible lacing and higher heel than the reference. Merchant labels sizes Women's US. All listed sizes verified available at $73.95.

options.title: COVEN BOOT - BLACK
options.notes: Black vegan-leather pointed ankle boot with silver buckle details, Velcro attachments, rear zipper, and 2-inch rubber heel. Adds conspicuous hardware compared with the plain reference. Only size 6 is available in the live feed at $120; do not advertise other sizes. Page says Shipping NOW.

options.title: Paris Boots (Black)
options.notes: Black leather lace-up ankle boots with 1.6-inch Cuban heel, cotton/leather lining, and leather sole. Merchant explicitly describes almond-shaped toes; these are less pointed than the reference and lower than the costume alternatives. Standard-width Women's US sizes listed here are verified available at $285; wide is a separate product.

gaps: The middle tier has only size 6 in stock. Premium Paris boots use an almond toe, not a sharply pointed toe.
